test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

English will be taught by Mr. Jha.

options.text: English would be taught by Mr. Jha.

solution:
The correct answer is **'**Mr. Jha will teach English'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the original sentence, the verb is in the passive voice, which emphasizes the action on the object (English) performed by the subject (Mr. Jha).
 
• In the active voice, the subject (Mr. Jha) performs the action on the object (English).
 
• The structure changes from "English will be taught by Mr. Jha" to "Mr. Jha will teach English," where the doer of the action (Mr. Jha) is at the beginning.
 
• Therefore, the correct active voice form of the sentence is "**Mr. Jha will teach English.**"

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Sentence in Active Voice: *Mr. Jha will teach English.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are incorrect for the following reasons:
 
• **Option 1: "Mr. Jha would teach English."**
 
 
• Reason: This sentence uses the conditional tense, which changes the meaning by implying a hypothetical situation. The original sentence uses the future tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: "English would be taught by Mr. Jha."**
 
 
• Reason: This sentence is still in the passive voice and uses the conditional tense, which does not match the original future tense.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "Mr. Jha teaches English."**
 
 
• Reason: This sentence uses the present simple tense, while the original sentence uses the future tense.
